svg.aria-label: Mandi Net-Price Desk. A Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 entry: three AI agents rank nearby mandis by what a trader actually clears.
svg.text: Three AI agents rank nearby mandis by what a trader
actually clears after freight, spoilage and fees,
using live government prices and real road routes.
With Laksh Pradhwani, Mark Patel and Saiansh Kathuria.
